mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS level below 0.2% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative or flat (<=0) in more than 50% of observations when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp from previous month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth is negative and HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: During high-inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 215), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a supply shock that reduces corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 550 thousand units indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative or flat (<=0) in more than 50% of observations when HOUST > 550.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), declining payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0) signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) indicate stagflationary supply shock, eroding corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 215.
